ownerDecisions20261119.legacyRealPaidEvidence authorizes confirmed unreconciled Cobro for exact unique policy edition, expected receipt reality, gross and actual paid date; protected environment and idempotency remain required.
D06: source-pinned deterministic AGREGAR delta through the existing protected writer, CAS, audit, rollback and readback, without repeating applied facts.

authority.text: Paula requests continuity and long financial writing batches, preserving prior preparations and decisions and avoiding duplicate reprocessing.

allowedDelta: Create one absent canonical historical expected receipt, one closed zero-debt portfolio ledger, one confirmed unreconciled Cobro and one audit for each uniquely proven paired-source paid obligation.
requiredConditions: Exactly one existing tenant/GT/GTQ/insurer/client/policy edition; preserve policy and coverage status byte-for-byte.
Pinned scheduled-receipt source and primary actual-payment source both attest the same candidate; all dates and net/gross values exact and no material source variation.

Complete bounded census of receipt, cartera and Cobro collections; examine relation aliases, orphan records, evidence aliases and natural obligation identity; any plausible competing record holds that row.
No preexisting receipt may be replaced or bypassed. Existing-receipt flows retain their own identity and financial gates.
Each record has a deterministic natural key, exact preimage CAS and immutable postimage comparison; replay creates zero.
Only the approved exact protected job may apply its freshly generated eligible plan; metadata or local tests are not write authorization or proof.
prohibited: No new policy, renewal, coverage activation, policy status change, invented insurer requirement or installment total.
No active/overdue debt, future calendar, automatic insurer/bank reconciliation, invoice, commission or payment-date inference.
No broad reimport, second writer, manual-gate bypass or claim that 146 observations guarantee 146 eligible writes.
